_confidence: LOW-MEDIUM AND PARTIAL — this is a spot-check anchor set, not a full ground truth. Transcribed by eye from a blurry, low-contrast phone photo (the same image that produced garbled OCR output) — the same font-blur ambiguities that break OCR (2 vs 3, 6 vs 8, decimal digits) also affect a human reader, including me. Antigen names below are cross-checked against the clearer 'Allele Equiv' column and are reasonably trustworthy; MFI values are best-effort and may be off by a digit or two in the decimals. This table has ~150-200 rows total across both pages — only a subset of clearly-legible high-signal rows (highest MFI on page 1, top rows on page 2) is transcribed here. DO NOT treat this as complete. Use it only as a rough sanity-check anchor (does the model find these antigens at roughly the right MFI, especially relative to the DSA_MFI_THRESHOLD=1000 cutoff), and independently eyeball the model's full output against the actual chart yourself before trusting this data for anything beyond the Phase 1 spike.
_scoring_guidance: Compare by antigen name (case-insensitive, ignore punctuation) and treat MFI as matching if within ~15% or both values fall on the same side of the 1000 MFI clinical threshold used elsewhere in this system (app/reference_data/dsa_threshold.py) — exact decimal match is not the goal here.
_bead_ids_note: Part I (bead-row identity / tile reconciliation) considered adding a 'bead' field to each anchor here, matching the source chart's own Bead column. Not done: the Bead column's print is small enough that transcribing it with real confidence from these photos wasn't possible, and a wrong fabricated bead ID baked into this fixture would look authoritative while actively misleading future debugging -- worse than not having one. test_bead_specificity_live.py instead asserts a structural invariant that doesn't need anchor ground truth: no bead ID may repeat in reconcile_bead_rows's own output (a duplicate there is a reconciliation bug, not scoring noise) and every bead ID falls inside the valid panel range.
